rationale: All five candidates transcribe the text perfectly with nothing invented, so the ranking rests only on small formatting differences. A, C and E reflow each item into a clean paragraph with items separated, and are nearly indistinguishable; the order among them is close to arbitrary. B keeps the scan's mid-sentence line breaks, which is faithful to the image but slightly worse as markdown. D does the same and also omits the blank line between items ① and ②, so it comes last.
